Local Establishment in Jammu & Kashmir The bidder should preferably have a registered office, branch office or operational establishment within th e Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. Documentary proof such as GST registration, trade licence, establis hment registration or other valid business registration showing the local address shall be submitted. 2. Local Operational Capability The bidder should demonstrate the capability to provide and operate the required Load Carrier Four-Wheel er within District Rajouri. Preference may be given only where permitted under applicable procurement rul es and duly approved by the competent authority. 3. Local Vehicle Availability The successful bidder shall ensure that the vehicle is stationed or readily available within District Rajouri d uring the contract period to facilitate timely transportation of medicines and medical supplies. 4. Employment of Local Driver The service provider is encouraged to engage a driver who is a resident of Jammu & Kashmir and familiar with the local geographical conditions, road connectivity and remote areas of District Rajouri. 5. Proof of Local Establishment The bidder claiming local establishment shall submit any of the following applicable documents: GST registration certificate reflecting the J&K business address. Valid Shop and Establishment Registration Certificate. Municipal or local trade licence. Other valid Government-issued proof of business establishment in J&K. 6. Local Service Support The successful bidder shall maintain adequate local operational arrangements for vehicle maintenance, re pairs and replacement in case of breakdown to ensure uninterrupted transportation services. 7. Vehicle Replacement Arrangement In case of breakdown, the service provider shall arrange a suitable replacement vehicle without undue del ay so that transportation of essential medicines and medical supplies is not affected. 8. Verification of Documents The department reserves the right to verify the authenticity of documents submitted by the bidder regardi ng its local establishment and operational capability. .
